mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right paint finish (e.g., matte, eggshell, semi-gloss) for different rooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right paint finish depends on the room's function and desired durability. Matte finishes hide imperfections well and offer a subtle look, ideal for low-traffic areas like bedrooms. Eggshell and satin finishes provide a soft sheen, are more durable, and easier to clean, making them suitable for living rooms and dining areas. Semi-gloss and high-gloss finishes are the most durable and washable, often chosen for kitchens, bathrooms, and trim due to their resistance to moisture and wear. Consider the amount of light in the room and how much traffic it receives when making your selection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a paint finish based on a room's function and durability needs: matte for low-traffic, eggshell/satin for living areas, and semi-gloss/high-gloss for kitchens, bathrooms, and trim.
